
# Security Policy

## Reporting a Vulnerability

If you discover a critical security vulnerability that could result in substantial financial loss for users in any live deployment of our smart contracts, frontend, or backend, please use the GitHub **"Report a Vulnerability"** feature (found under the Security tab of this repository).

Your report will be sent privately to the maintainers, who will review it and provide a fair assessment based on the real impact, following the Immunefi bug bounty program classification.

**Important:** Your report must include either a clear proof-of-concept script that can be run privately, or a detailed, step-by-step description of how to reproduce the vulnerability.

**Please do not disclose security vulnerabilities publicly or in issues.**

Thank you for helping to keep Sovryn and its users safe.
